MUS.note: The document names AI-generated content and deepfakes as challenges but states no AI law, rule or draft.
It says only that the government is preparing bills and amendments on cybersecurity and cybercrime, with no draft text, status or date named; incident counts are not use of the law.
No data protection law is stated.
No identity law is stated; identity theft is mentioned only as an online harm.
No electronic transactions or e-commerce law is stated.
No law on public bodies sharing data is stated.
